verdict.rationale: The Teams platform docs list app surfaces that support interactive in-chat experiences: message extensions, suggested actions (clickable buttons in conversations), bots, tab apps, and a guide for porting Slack Bolt apps. However, the evidence is mostly bare headings and never describes structured message layouts or modal dialogs. Missing for 10: any evidence of a card or layout framework for structured messages, modal/dialog support, detail on how buttons and actions are handled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
